Selected work

VP Communications and Marketing · SASS · Apr 2025 – Apr 2026

Running the SASS Instagram

As VP of Communications and Marketing for the Society of Arts and Social Sciences (SASS) at SFU, I managed the society's social media: event posters, election and council announcements, and "a day in the life" reels. Over my term, engagement across all of our platforms grew by 10%.

I also planned the promotion for SASS events with the rest of the executive team. Events I promoted include Clubs Day, the SASS Formal (Sass & Spritz), Fright Fest, Game Night, Coffee with Profs and the 2026 NATO Field School info session.

Volunteer UX/UI designer · UNICEF Vancouver · Oct – Dec 2025

Redesigning the Sustainable Development Goals page

I redesigned UNICEF Vancouver's Sustainable Development Goals page in Figma, in desktop and mobile versions. The page opens with the line "A Better World For All", then covers the 17 goals, the team's recent events and a "Take Action" section for people who want to get involved.

The brief

The page had to explain the 17 Sustainable Development Goals and the team's work without a wall of text, make it easy for students to get involved, and be practical for the product development team to build.

Process

I built high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, and worked with the design team to make sure the solutions met their practical requirements. The official SDG icons sit in a grid so the 17 goals read as one block, and the rest of the palette stays navy and white so the colourful icons stand out. Each event is a card with a photo, the goals it relates to and a short summary, so new events can be added without redesigning the page. I designed desktop and mobile side by side so everything stacks cleanly on a phone.

Outcome

A finished desktop and mobile design handed to the product development team, which cut their development cycle by 20%.
